map.折射率可以小于 1 吗？: Can the refractive index be less than 1?
map.按 n=c/v，若算得 n<1 说明介质中光速大于真空光速，这违背狭义相对论，通: Using n=c/v, if the computed n<1 it means light travels faster in the medium than in a vacuum, which violates special relativity and usually means the input is wrong (such as the units or confusing group velocity with phase velocity). Ordinary transparent media have n≥1.
map.折射率与波长有关吗？: Does the refractive index depend on wavelength?
map.有关，这就是色散。同一材料对短波（蓝紫光）的折射率通常更大，因此棱镜能把白光分解: Yes, that is dispersion. The same material usually has a higher refractive index for short wavelengths (blue and violet), which is why a prism splits white light into a spectrum. State the wavelength used in the calculation; the common reference is n_D at the sodium yellow line of 589 nm.
